known_issues.title: Front brake squeal when cold (demo)
known_issues.symptoms: Squeal for the first few stops on cold mornings.
known_issues.fix: Revised shims per DEMO-TSB-01; clean and lube the caliper slides.

known_issues.title: Rough idle from a dirty throttle body (demo)
known_issues.fix: Clean the throttle body and relearn idle.

symptom_diagnosis.symptom: Squeal when braking in the morning

likely_causes.cause: Surface rust / moisture on the rotors
likely_causes.how_to_check: Does it stop after 3-5 stops? Then it's normal.

likely_causes.cause: Worn pad shims or dry caliper slides
likely_causes.how_to_check: Pull a wheel; look at the shims and slide pins.
likely_causes.fix: Clean and grease slides; replace shims.

recommendations.item: Check the front brake pad thickness
recommendations.why: The squeal could be the wear indicator (demo).
